# ractermx_security_checks (Data Source)

Reads security findings for a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read security findings for a domain.
data "ractermx_security_checks" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
}

output "findings_count" {
  value = length(data.ractermx_security_checks.example.findings)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `findings` (Attributes List) List of security findings grouped by pillar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--findings))

<a id="nestedatt--findings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `findings`

Read-Only:

- `check_id` (String) The unique identifier of the check.
- `description` (String) A description of the check.
- `fix_available` (Boolean) Whether an automated fix is available.
- `name` (String) The name of the check.
- `pillar` (String) The security pillar (identity, shadow, reputation).
- `severity` (String) The severity level of the finding.
- `status` (String) The status of the finding (pass, fail, warning).
